For \( n = 3 \), \( f_3(x) = f_2(\sqrt{9 - x}) \). The domain requires \( \sqrt{9 - x} \in [3, 4] \), leading to \( -7 \leq x \leq 0 \). Thus, the domain is \([-7, 0]\).

For \( n = 5 \), \( f_5(x) = f_4(\sqrt{25 - x}) \). The domain requires \( \sqrt{25 - x} = 16 \), leading to \( 25 - x = 256 \), hence \( x = -231 \). Thus, the domain is \(\{-231\}\).
